article.title: 更進新聞：騰訊發布Hy4權重，提供三種模型版本
article.title_en: Update: Tencent publishes Hy4 weights in three variants
article.summary: 騰訊已發布Hy4完整模型權重，提供指令版、FP8版及預訓練base版，讓團隊評估自行部署。
article.summary_en: Tencent published full Hy4 weights as instruction-tuned, FP8 and pretrained-base variants for deployment evaluation.
highlights: 模型卡列出文字、圖像及影片理解，以及約100萬token上下文。
採用Tencent Hy License，商業使用安排須按該授權條款核對。
highlights_en: The card lists text, image and video understanding with roughly one million context tokens.
Weights use the Tencent Hy License; commercial arrangements follow its terms.
article.why: 權重接入讓技術團隊多一種部署選擇，行銷資料應用可評估哪些跨檔分析值得在自有環境測試，再決定是否投入運算資源。
article.why_en: Technical teams can assess which campaign-document tasks merit testing in their own environment before committing compute resources.
article.next_step: 先以一份已有標準答案的活動文件包列出文字、圖片及表格任務，請技術團隊評估容量、部署版本及授權條件。
article.next_step_en: Define text, image and table tasks in a campaign document set with known answers, then assess capacity, variant and license requirements.
article.detail: 11月5日版報道時權重仍屬計劃，這次可核對的進展是模型檔案與官方部署資料已公開。Base版是預訓練模型，不能直接當作已調整好的聊天版本。團隊可先用指令版安排有限測試，分開估算運算、維護及資料處理要求，再比較自行部署與既有託管服務的適用工作。
article.detail_en: Our November 5 issue described weights as planned. Checkpoint links and official deployment information are now public. The base checkpoint is pretrained rather than a chat-tuned version. Evaluate compute, maintenance and data-handling needs separately when comparing an instruction model with hosted access.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
article.followup: 11月5日版報道Hy4託管推出及權重計劃；11月20日官方程式庫提供模型權重與部署資料。
article.followup_en: Our November 5 issue covered hosted Hy4 and planned weights. The November 20 official repository supplies checkpoint links and deployment material.
